objective: Keep mutable expert storage while replacing the 302-split CPU-policy topology with a persistent GPU slot map and the 152-split exact CPU-fallback topology.

root_cause.explanation: The legacy dynamic path exposes a CPU mutable-route policy island, GPU hot branch, CPU cold branch/merge preparation, and GPU continuation at every MoE layer. Expert H2D upload is a separate promotion-worker path.

all_layers_cuda_graphs_off.configuration: one synchronously warmed resident expert per MoE layer, no post-warmup admission

all_layers_cuda_graphs_on.configuration: 16 warmup plus 32 measured tokens, one synchronously warmed resident expert per MoE layer, no post-warmup admission

async_warmstart.configuration: one asynchronously warmed resident expert per layer, CUDA Graphs enabled, no decode-time admission
async_warmstart.promotion_readback: byte-for-byte verification passed for sampled component shapes

final_retained_source_validation.configuration: 16 warmup plus 32 measured tokens, async one-slot-per-layer warm-start, no post-warmup admission, CUDA Graphs enabled

code_fixes.change: Clear stale CUDA tensor metadata before rebinding graph tensors to cache-owned persistent buffers.
code_fixes.key_code: tensor_copy->buffer = nullptr; tensor_copy->data = nullptr; tensor_copy->extra = nullptr; ggml_backend_tensor_alloc(...)

code_fixes.change: Make set-rows D2H validation strictly opt-in; its stream synchronization is illegal during CUDA graph capture.
code_fixes.key_code: GGML_MOE_DYNAMIC_VALIDATE_SET_ROWS is no longer implied by fixed-topology mode

code_fixes.change: Maintain a stable per-layer device slot map and mapped-ID buffer, updating map contents by generation without changing graph pointers.
CPU MMID skips canonical expert routes currently published as resident, preserving exact hot/cold exclusivity.
Build CPU cold branch before GPU hot branch, use canonical IDs with GPU slot remapping, merge complementary outputs on GPU, and reduce fixed-topology decode to two backend segments per layer.
Expose and record fixed-topology, admission, warm-start, async-promotion, predictor, and urgent-upload controls.

failed_or_reverted_experiments.experiment: Implicit set-rows validation during graph capture
failed_or_reverted_experiments.cause: cudaStreamSynchronize during active stream capture is prohibited
failed_or_reverted_experiments.resolution: fixed; validation is now explicit opt-in

failed_or_reverted_experiments.notes: Failure persisted with urgent upload disabled and with CUDA Graphs disabled.
Failure reproduced with synchronous promotion and with the generic safe MMID fallback.

failed_or_reverted_experiments.experiment: Use the CPU custom-op route snapshot directly as GPU MMID IDs
failed_or_reverted_experiments.notes: Scheduler use of the custom-op tensor as a GPU branch input failed before cache initialization.

failed_or_reverted_experiments.experiment: Deduplicate repeated route IDs in cache scoring
failed_or_reverted_experiments.notes: Repeated IDs were a downstream symptom, not the root cause.

sanitizer_result.first_localized_failure: Invalid global write in k_set_rows<float, int, __half>
sanitizer_result.interpretation: The promotion worker did not write expert buffers out of bounds. Upstream numerical or routing-state corruption reaches a later SET_ROWS operation. The multi-slot path is not safe to enable.

retention_decision.safe_checkpoint: opt-in fixed topology with a stable published map and no decode-time multi-slot mutation
retention_decision.reason: The structural speedup is proven, but multi-slot/full mutable correctness remains unresolved.

next_minimal_work: Add a finite/range validator immediately after each fixed-topology MoE merge to identify the first corrupt layer before the later SET_ROWS failure.
Compare fixed hot, fixed cold, and merged tensors against the legacy graph for the first failing token/layer.
Once numerical parity is restored, add per-slot compute-use events and event-driven map publication for decode-time replacement.
Only then enable the learned predictor/MLP on the fixed topology.
